title: Relief wake fires only on a WALL-tier hold lift: a window that pauses at urgent-90 never gets .holdlifted, and the stamp's promised resume is the cap-walled queue's return (15:02) not the active account's own 5h reset (03:10). Fix in claude_rotate.py: at urgent-90 the promise = the active account's earliest window reset; the tick writes the lift marker for every armed self-watch when that instant passes (or the session % drops below the urgent line), not only on a stamp clear; plus a timed-wake fallback in selfwatch_arm.sh from --status so a window needs no tick to wake. Measured 2026-10-07 01:12: hold WARNING since 01:06, wall never armed, watcher waiting on .errparked/.holdlifted only (claude-selfwatch.sh:43-62, claude_rotate.py:6027-6066, :6714-6800).
